task.description: tree-sitter-typescript maxes out at 0.23.2 on crates.io and requires tree-sitter ^0.24. Because tree-sitter links = tree-sitter, multiple versions cannot coexist in the workspace dependency graph.
task.title: Evaluate tree-sitter 0.27 upgrade once tree-sitter-typescript publishes compatible bindings

events.description: Evaluated 2026-10-28: tree-sitter 0.27.1 is released, but tree-sitter-typescript is still 0.23.2 (aimed at the 0.24/0.25 line). Upgrading miter/dado to tree-sitter 0.27 before the TypeScript/Rust/Python grammars publish 0.27-compatible bindings risks ABI/language-version mismatches across the AST indexer. Stays deferred until those grammar crates ship.
